name: Lillie Langtry
bio: Emily Charlotte Le Breton of Jersey, 'considered the most beautiful woman of her generation' in the editors' words; she married Edward Langtry in her teens, was brought by him to London, and became a leading Society figure and, as the editors put it, a friend of the Prince of Wales. Painted by Whistler, Poynter, Watts, Burne-Jones, Leighton and particularly Millais, whose portrait The Jersey Lily gave her the nickname; Wilde's friend Frank Miles made many drawings of her. In 1899 she married Hugo Gerald de Bathe.
bio_sources: Holland & Hart-Davis, editorial note, Complete Letters (2000), p. 91 n. 2
